what: The YouTube Tag Generator turns your video title into a set of relevant tags. It finds the main subject of the title, drops filler words like "how to" and "the", and builds tags around it for the type of video you make, such as tutorials, reviews, gaming, recipes, music or Shorts.

Tags are grouped into main tags, related phrases and broad tags. A strong starting set is picked for you, and you can tap any tag to add or remove it or type your own. The counter uses YouTube's own rules, including commas and the extra characters for tags with spaces, so you never go over 500.
Copy the tags as a comma-separated list for YouTube Studio, or as hashtags for your description. Nothing is sent anywhere; your last set of tags is kept on this device.
uses: Fill the Tags box in seconds with relevant terms.
Add short-form tags and hashtags for your description.
Cover the different ways people search for the same skill.
Add "worth it", "pros and cons" and comparison searches.
Refresh the tags on videos that get few views.
tutorial: Enter your video title or main topic in the first box.
Add other words people might search for, separated by commas.
The type adds suitable phrases, like "recipe" or "walkthrough".
Press Generate tags. A starting set appears under "Your tags".
Tap tags in the groups to add them, tap a chosen tag to remove it, or type your own and press Add.
Press Copy tags and paste into YouTube Studio, or Copy as hashtags for your description.
features: Removes filler words and video-type words to find what the video is about.
Tutorial, review, vlog, gaming, music, Shorts, education, recipe, news or any.
Counts commas and quotes like YouTube.
Up to 15 hashtags for your description.

example.title: Worked example: a bread recipe video
example.text: Type "How to make sourdough bread at home" and choose Recipe. The tool finds "sourdough bread" and suggests tags like sourdough bread recipe, easy sourdough bread recipe, homemade sourdough bread and sourdough bread at home, plus broad tags such as recipe and cooking. It picks 15 tags using 324 of 500 characters. Press Copy tags and paste them into YouTube Studio.

tips: Put your most important tag first; it often matches your main keyword.
Use tags that describe the video honestly; misleading tags can break YouTube's rules.
Add common misspellings or other names for your topic.
Spend most effort on the title, thumbnail and first lines of the description.
problems: It would take you over 500 characters. Remove a tag first.
Write a clearer title, or add your main keyword in "Extra keywords".
Pasting into YouTube made one long tag
Paste into the Tags box itself; YouTube splits tags at each comma.
